system.name: Brain-JEPA
system.one_liner: A brain dynamics foundation model that predicts latent representations of masked fMRI blocks from one observation block, with gradient positioning and spatiotemporal masking.

content.variant_note: left column of input data and masks, middle column of two encoders joined by an EMA arrow, right frame of three aligned predictor rows; four circled steps match the caption
content.argues: Brain-JEPA predicts latent representations of three kinds of target blocks from one observation block, using brain-gradient positions and spatiotemporal masks, with an EMA target encoder.
content.subject: fMRI ROI time series cut into patches, masked into observation and target blocks, encoded, positioned and predicted in latent space

elements.name: Input Data
elements.role: fMRI time series of the brain parcels (ROI#1 ... ROI#N) over the timestep axis, cut into patches
elements.drawn_as: grey wiggly curves in a grid of dashed cells, ROI labels at the left, arrows from a head icon, one cell filled blue and labelled One Patch

elements.name: Patchify + Shuffle ROIs
elements.role: step 1: split the series into patches after shuffling ROIs
elements.drawn_as: bold caption beside a black circled 1 and a scissors icon

elements.name: Spatiotemporal Masking
elements.role: step 2: splits everything but the observation block into Cross-ROIs (alpha), Cross-Time (beta) and Double-Cross (gamma) regions and samples targets from each
elements.drawn_as: titled lattice of cells hatched in blue, green or red by region, a few solid red, blue or green target blocks, an orange-framed Observation block in the middle

elements.name: Targets / Cross-ROIs / Cross-Time / Double-Cross
elements.role: key to the mask: solid = targets, hatch = regions
elements.drawn_as: grey strip under the lattice with a slashed-eye icon and four swatches with letters alpha, beta, gamma

elements.name: Observation
elements.role: the single visible block given to the encoder
elements.drawn_as: white card with an orange frame, an orange eye icon and a grey label; one inside the lattice and one copy before the encoder

elements.name: Targets
elements.role: the blocks to be predicted, one colour per region
elements.drawn_as: three bars of cells: red of three, blue of two, green of two, under a grey label

elements.name: Observation Encoder f_theta
elements.role: ViT observation encoder (per the caption) that gives the observation representation
elements.drawn_as: grey rounded rectangle with two offset copies behind it, italic f with theta

elements.name: Target Encoder f_theta-bar
elements.role: encoder that gives the target representations; its parameters follow the observation encoder by EMA
elements.drawn_as: same stacked grey rounded rectangle, theta with a bar

elements.name: EMA
elements.role: incremental update of the target encoder from the observation encoder
elements.drawn_as: brown double-chevron arrow pointing down, brown label

elements.name: s_x
elements.role: patch-level representation of the observation block
elements.drawn_as: column of orange dots in a pale orange capsule, repeated once per predictor row

elements.name: Brain Gradient Positioning
elements.role: positional embedding of ROIs from brain functional gradients
elements.drawn_as: line-art brain with coloured curved arrows (green, orange, blue, purple) to ROI#1, ROI#2, ROI#3 ... ROI#N, repeated per row

elements.name: Temporal Positioning
elements.role: sine and cosine positional embedding of timesteps
elements.drawn_as: small axes with two overlaid grey wave curves under a Timestep axis, coloured dots mark the target positions

elements.name: g_phi (predictor)
elements.role: step 3: narrower ViT that predicts target representations from s_x conditioned on the positional embedding
elements.drawn_as: tall grey rounded rectangle, three copies, one per target type

elements.name: predicted representation (s-hat_y^r)
elements.role: prediction for a target block of region r
elements.drawn_as: small column of red, blue or green dots in an orange-bordered pale capsule at the right of each row

elements.name: target representation (s_y^r)
elements.role: representation of a target block from the target encoder
elements.drawn_as: short pill of red, blue or green dots on a tinted ground, three pills stacked under the right frame

elements.name: L2 (MSE)
elements.role: step 4: loss that aligns predicted and target representations
elements.drawn_as: label with a black circled 4; dashed grey arrows return from each prediction to its target pill

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a structured mask as a lattice: hatch the regions by type, fill the sampled targets solid, frame the visible block in a contrasting colour, then carry each region's colour through the encoders' outputs and the loss lines.
lessons.suits: masked-prediction or JEPA-style self-supervised methods with structured masks over a grid (images, video, fMRI, time series).

evidence: Instead of reconstructing masked patches of fMRI time series, Brain-JEPA operates in the latent space
Brain-JEPA employs a single observation block to predict the representations of target blocks.
Brain-JEPA aims to predict representations of multiple target blocks based on the representation of a single observation block.

summary: Brain-JEPA is a brain dynamics foundation model that predicts latent representations instead of reconstructing fMRI patches. The figure is a left-to-right architecture drawing with four circled steps. At left, ROI time series are cut into patches (step 1) and a hatched lattice shows Spatiotemporal Masking into Cross-ROIs, Cross-Time and Double-Cross regions with one orange observation block and coloured targets (step 2). In the middle an observation encoder and an EMA-updated target encoder process the blocks; at right three predictor rows add brain-gradient and temporal position embeddings (step 3) and dashed arrows align predictions with targets by L2 loss (step 4).
summary_zh: Brain-JEPA 在潜空间预测 fMRI 块的表征。图自左向右带四个圆圈步骤：时序分块，斜线格子展示时空掩码，中间观察编码器与 EMA 更新的目标编码器，右侧三行预测器加位置编码，虚线箭头对齐预测与目标。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The caption names the regions Cross-ROI (alpha), Cross-Time (beta), Double-Cross (gamma), matching the key in the figure; the body text swaps alpha and beta. The meaning of the slashed eye in the key is read as hidden regions and is not stated in the text. Which colour belongs to which predictor row is read from the dot counts (red three, blue two, green two).
